pageTitle: "Support Group: Characters" Open for a Limited Time~ Join for a Chance to Win Exquisite Merchandise!
name: "Support Group: Characters" Open for a Limited Time~ Join for a Chance to Win Exquisite Merchandise!
description: Olah! Hello, Travelers~ To help you navigate the land of Teyvat more smoothly, the "Hilichurl Support Group" is once again open! Whether you're a budding new Traveler who doesn't know where to start, an experienced Traveler looking to improve to challenge more difficult levels, or an avid Traveler who is willing to share your gaming experiences, you can join a team to help one another. The theme of this issue is "Characters." You can ask questions regarding "Characters" according to your playing experience or answer other Travelers' questions about it. Travelers who actively participate will have the opportunity to win merchandise!
